description:
Canonical prompts per family for scaffold-wide eval. One prompt per family, seeded from tests/coverage.test.ts FAMILY_PROMPTS — the same prompts that already prove the family ROUTES correctly. Evaluating these confirms the family also COMPOSES + BUILDS + JUDGES cleanly.

Workspace prompts (multi-project) live in a separate workspaces array below; keep families-vs-workspaces partitioned so sampling can draw from each pool independently.
